central.disconnected: This server is no longer connected to Central.

power.title: This key has full administrator access
power.body: Anyone holding it can create and delete sites, databases, system users and firewall rules on this server. The key cannot be limited or made read-only.
power.attribution: Anything done with it is recorded in the activity log under a separate account, so you can tell it apart from your own changes.

actions.generateHint: The key is shown once, right after it's created. You won't be able to see it again.

reveal.title: Your connection key
reveal.warning: Copy this key now. For your security it will not be shown again — if you lose it, you'll have to generate a new one.
reveal.next: Paste it into your central panel to finish connecting.

current.label: Connection key
current.lost: Only part of the key is shown. If you've lost it, generate a new one — Central will stop working until you paste the new key in.

confirmGenerate.title: Allow Central management?
confirmGenerate.description: This grants ServerAvatar Central Panel full management access to this server.
confirmGenerate.acknowledgement: I understand this key grants ServerAvatar Central Panel management access to this server, and I want to proceed.

confirmRegenerate.title: Generate a new key?
confirmRegenerate.description: The current key stops working immediately. Central will lose access to this server until you paste the new key into it.

confirmDisconnect.title: Disconnect Central?
confirmDisconnect.description: Central loses access to this server immediately, and anything it is doing right now will fail. You can reconnect later, but it will need a new key.
